name: BFO (core taxonomy)
description: The upper is-a taxonomy of the Basic Formal Ontology (BFO 2.0): Entity ⊐ {Continuant, Occurrent}; IndependentContinuant ⊐ MaterialEntity ⊐ {Object, FiatObjectPart, ObjectAggregate}; the realizable line Quality / Role / Disposition ⊐ Function; with Continuant/Occurrent and the three dependence kinds disjoint. A pure T-box and a second real upper ontology beside SUMO — imported from OWL functional syntax through the OWL→CLIF→EGI pipeline.
